Given force field $F = x^3\hat{i} + y\hat{j} + z\hat{k}$ and path from point $A(1, 2, 3)$ to $B(3, 5, 7)$. 
The work done $W$ is given by the line integral: $W = \int_C F \cdot dr$. 
Parametric equations of the line segment joining $(1, 2, 3)$ and $(3, 5, 7)$ using parameter $t \in [0, 1]$: 
$x = 1 + (3 - 1)t = 1 + 2t \implies dx = 2dt$ 
$y = 2 + (5 - 2)t = 2 + 3t \implies dy = 3dt$ 
$z = 3 + (7 - 3)t = 3 + 4t \implies dz = 4dt$ 

Substitute into $F \cdot dr = F_x dx + F_y dy + F_z dz$: 
$F \cdot dr = (1+2t)^3(2dt) + (2+3t)(3dt) + (3+4t)(4dt)$. 

Integrating from $t = 0$ to $1$: 
$W = \int_{0}^{1} \left[ 2(1+2t)^3 + 3(2+3t) + 4(3+4t) ight] dt$ 
$= \left[ 2  rac{(1+2t)^4}{4(2)} + 3 \left(2t +  rac{3t^2}{2}ight) + 4 \left(3t +  rac{4t^2}{2}ight) ight]_0^1$ 
$= \left[  rac{(1+2t)^4}{4} + 6t +  rac{9t^2}{2} + 12t + 8t^2 ight]_0^1$ 
$= \left[  rac{(1+2t)^4}{4} + 18t +  rac{25}{2}t^2 ight]_0^1$ 

At $t = 1$: $ rac{(3)^4}{4} + 18(1) +  rac{25}{2}(1)^2 =  rac{81}{4} + 18 +  rac{25}{2} =  rac{81 + 72 + 50}{4} =  rac{203}{4}$. 
At $t = 0$: $ rac{(1)^4}{4} + 0 + 0 =  rac{1}{4}$. 

$W =  rac{203}{4} -  rac{1}{4} =  rac{202}{4} = 50.5$.
proTip: Parametrize straight lines using $r(t) = r_0 + t(r_1 - r_0)$ where $0 \le t \le 1$.
